en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting a large hilltop complex with a medieval castle-like structure and an attached Gothic cathedral with tall twin spires. The buildings stand above a riverfront town with smaller houses and industrial-looking structures in the foreground. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Meissen and mention the royal Albrechtsburg castle and cathedral.
